test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The image below shows a cross between two plants up to F2 generation. Some conclusions that can be drawn from this cross are stated below. Which option gives the INCORRECT conclusion?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf9f6b6a859af039497f04c8718a5ad72a37fc209e95b2123db03c5ae7e5d05b.png]

options.text: Traits are inherited but not expressed.
Both red and green are dominant though less number of green are produced.

solution:
The incorrect answer is **__'____Both red and green are dominant though less number of green are produced__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• F1 produced **all colored flowers**. So it is a dominant trait and the **Green flower is recessive**. Thus Only the **Red color is dominant**. The recessive nature of the green flower made his traits not expressive.
 
• F2 produced colored flowered plants **Red and Green** flowered plants in** a 3:1 ratio.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf9f6b6a859af039497f04c8718a5ad72a37fc209e95b2123db03c5ae7e5d05b.png]
